title: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an authorization flaw in the customer…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contain an authorization flaw in the customer portal Issue list. This flaw causes inconsistent scoping of records between the list and detail views, allowing authenticated users, including portal users without roles, to access other customers' Issues by sending crafted requests.
